WITH daily AS (
  SELECT fish_date_t AS d, SUM(yt)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
  FROM trips
  WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
  GROUP BY 1
),
uw AS (
  SELECT date_t AS d, AVG(cuti) AS cuti, AVG(beuti) AS beuti
  FROM upwelling
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  corr(daily.ypa, u0.cuti) AS corr_cuti_lag0,
  corr(daily.ypa, u7.cuti) AS corr_cuti_lag7,
  corr(daily.ypa, u14.cuti) AS corr_cuti_lag14,
  corr(daily.ypa, u0.beuti) AS corr_beuti_lag0,
  corr(daily.ypa, u7.beuti) AS corr_beuti_lag7,
  count(*) AS n
FROM daily
LEFT JOIN uw u0 ON u0.d = daily.d
LEFT JOIN uw u7 ON u7.d = daily.d - 7
LEFT JOIN uw u14 ON u14.d = daily.d - 14
